list.name: training_run_id
list.query: SELECT training_run_id::text FROM training_run_corpus ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, training_run_id, status, games, candidate_episodes, eligible_cycles, incomplete_cycles FROM training_run_corpus WHERE training_run_id::text = '$training_run_id' ORDER BY created_at DESC

panels.title: MAE продаж за цикл: train / validation / test (штук, n)

targets.rawSql: SELECT training_run_id, algorithm, split, n, mae, median_absolute_error, zero_sales_n, zero_sales_mae, overestimated, underestimated FROM training_run_models WHERE training_run_id::text = '$training_run_id' ORDER BY algorithm, split
SELECT created_at AS time, training_run_id, status, dataset, games, cycles, champion, version, artifact_sha256 FROM training_run_corpus ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Ошибки по рынкам, политикам, диапазонам цены и горизонта (штук / цикл, n)

targets.rawSql: SELECT training_run_id, algorithm, split, dimension, category, n, mae, median_absolute_error, zero_sales_n FROM training_run_slices WHERE training_run_id::text = '$training_run_id' ORDER BY dimension, category, algorithm, split

panels.title: Парная оценка: деньги после долгов (n независимых пар)

targets.rawSql: SELECT evaluation_series_id, model_version, market, count(*) AS started_pairs, count(model_minus_rules) AS full_applicable_pairs, round(avg(model_minus_rules),2) AS mean_advantage_after_debt, percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY model_minus_rules) AS median_advantage_after_debt, count(*) FILTER (WHERE model_minus_rules>0) AS model_wins FROM experiment_evaluation_pairs GROUP BY evaluation_series_id,model_version,market ORDER BY evaluation_series_id DESC,market

panels.title: Возврат к правилам: причины (n возможностей решений)

targets.rawSql: SELECT evaluation_series_id, market, reason, sum(opportunities) AS fallback_opportunities FROM experiment_fallback_reasons GROUP BY evaluation_series_id,market,reason ORDER BY evaluation_series_id DESC,market,reason
SELECT training_run_id, feature_version, feature, train_min, train_max FROM training_run_feature_ranges WHERE training_run_id::text='$training_run_id' ORDER BY feature
